description: Begin a consent with one bank, valid for 180 days, over every account the bank offers. To renew a stored consent, pass the bank, country and psu_type list_stored_sessions shows for it. Returns a URL a HUMAN must open: the bank requires strong customer authentication, so this step cannot be automated. After approval the bank redirects to the configured redirect_url with ?code=... in the query; that URL, or just the code, goes into complete_auth. Moves money or makes a legal document: the client asks the user to approve each call.

aspsp_name.description: The bank: the name field from list_aspsps, exactly as spelled there.

psu_type.description: Whose accounts: business or personal (list_aspsps says which the bank offers).

state.description: Echoed back on the redirect; useful to tell flows apart.

name: start_auth
title: Begin a bank consent
